items.title: Fact 10 for the literal energy truncation

source.anchor: Section4.1.1 footnote3 and Eq17; Section6.2 Fact10
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, CC BY4.0. ASTIS adaptation and formalization; no endorsement implied.

items.statement: For positive integer n and positive β,λ, define ρ(t)=exp(−1/t) for t>0 and zero otherwise, φ(t)=∫₀ᵗ ρ(2−|s|)/(ρ(2−|s|)+ρ(|s|−1)) ds, and U(y)=nβ²/λ·φ(λy/(nβ)). If Y is centered Gaussian, possibly degenerate, and a∈[0,1], then exp(−aU(Y)) is integrable and E exp(−aU(Y))≤exp(β² Var(Y)/2). This scalar statement permits any positive β,λ; the paper's recursive choices are a later instantiation.
assumptions: Y has a centered Gaussian probability law, including variance zero.
The deterministic gate a lies in [0,1].

obligations.label: Define exactly the source load on positive parameters
Derive measurability, oddness and sublinearity from the integral
Prove integrability and the bound on any Gaussian probability space

bindings.boundary: This is the literal scalar energy load and Fact10. The recursive selection of amplitudes, higher smoothness/cap/plateau properties, coefficient fields and conditional product iteration are separate. Lemma6.2 and all main lower bounds remain open.

assumption_deltas.reason: Positive carriers exclude off-source zero-denominator parameters. Every positive β,λ is allowed in this scalar result; their Eq18 recursion is not constructed.

assumption_deltas.source: φ is the footnote3 oriented integral of the rho quotient; U_i is Eq17
assumption_deltas.lean: Literal expNegInvGlue quotient and interval integral
assumption_deltas.reason: expNegInvGlue is exactly rho; the proof identifies the integrand with the existing smoothUnitCutoff, rather than choosing a different cutoff.
